subject: Kaizen: Request for encryption log index and signed key proofs
messages:
From: Clara Voss <clara.voss@kaizen.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurements@kaizen.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Request: encryption log index & signed key proofs

Hi Naomi / Irene,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Kaizen is moving through our SIG/CAIQ review and SOC 2 checklist and we have a handful of artifacts we need to close out before the vendor approval meeting next week. Can you please confirm you can provide the following items and an estimated delivery date?

- HSM attestation (latest firmware version and vendor-signed statement) or equivalent KMS attestation
- Key rotation ledger for the past 12 months (timestamps + operator id + rotation reason)
- Sample of wrapped key metadata (fingerprints only; no raw key material) for one tenant-bound KEK and one transport-wrapped KEK
- Evidence of in-transit encryption (TLS versions / ciphers used for inter-region replication)
- Short README describing retention policy for rotation logs and where they are stored (S3 path or transfer mechanism)

We attached the relevant SIG worksheet (Kaizen_SIG_q1.xlsx) with the fields we care about. If there are items you cannot provide exactly, please indicate the equivalent deliverable. Target: 7 business days if possible.

Also confirm how we will receive artifacts (secure SFTP, signed S3 presigned URL, or secure SharePoint). If there's an internal point-of-contact for forensic redaction requests, please loop them in.

Best,
Clara Voss
Senior Security Analyst
Kaizen Financial
Attachment: Kaizen_SIG_q1.xlsx (questionnaire)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Voss <clara.voss@kaizen.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption log index & signed key proofs

Hi Clara — thanks for the checklist and for laying out the scope so clearly. We can provide the items you listed with the following caveats and delivery plan: 

Planned deliverables and timeline (internal owners):
- HSM attestation PDF (Irene Choi will coordinate with our HSM vendor & signatory) — ETA 3 business days
- Key rotation ledger export (redacted operator IDs; full timestamps + rotation reasons) — ETA 5 business days (Connor O'Brien to prepare)
- Wrapped key metadata (fingerprints + algorithm/curve, no key material) — ETA 4 business days
- TLS/in-transit cipher inventory + cross-region replication note — ETA 2 business days
- Retention README and storage index (S3 path and ACLs) — ETA 2 business days

Delivery mechanism: secure SFTP + ephemeral signed S3 links for large artifacts. We will not export any raw key material; any cryptographic artifacts will be hash/fingerprint-only.

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and send incremental uploads to the SFTP endpoint you provide. If you need a formal statement for SIG/SOC2 reviewers (signed by our security lead), indicate which items require signature and we'll route them through legal.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: none

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Kaizen artifacts - plan and checklist

Naomi / Connor — quick internal note following Clara's ask. I'm taking point on the HSM attestation and will request the vendor-signed pdf today. Connor, can you produce the rotation export as CSV with these columns: rotation_time_utc, key_id, keystore_alias, operator_id (redacted), rotation_reason, rotation_type, verification_fingerprint. We'll also provide a short script that computes the verification fingerprint so reviewers can reproduce locally (script will be checksummed, no key material).

Checklist / redaction rules:
- Operator IDs: replace with hashed identifiers (sha256 of user@redwood) and include mapping only for audit team if required under NDA
- No raw key material leaves our environment; only fingerprints, wrapped-key metadata, attestation PDFs
- SFTP deliveries will be encrypted at rest; access will be time-limited and require 2FA.

Planned attachments for Kaizen: rotation_log_sample.csv (sample 30 rows), hsm_attestation_signed.pdf (vendor), tls_cipher_inventory.txt

I'll prepare the S3 bucket manifest and a one-page README describing retention (90 days on hot, 2 years in cold archive), plus the IAM policy snippet showing read-only access for Kaizen.

Irene Choi
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): rotation_log_sample.csv, hsm_attestation_signed.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Voss <clara.voss@kaizen.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com, procurements@kaizen.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption log index & signed key proofs

Hi Clara — following up with the artifacts we discussed. We uploaded the initial bundle to a time-limited SFTP directory and created presigned S3 URLs for the larger files. Below is a short manifest of what we placed and what is intentionally omitted: 

Delivered (links provided in the secure portal):
- hsm_attestation_signed.pdf — vendor-signed attestation (no secrets)
- rotation_log_2025-06_to_2026-06.csv — rotation_time_utc, key_id, keystore_alias, operator_hash, rotation_reason, rotation_type, verification_fingerprint
- wrapped_key_metadata_sample.json (fingerprints + algorithm metadata only)
- tls_cipher_inventory.txt — TLS versions and cipher suites used for inter-region replication
- retention_README.txt — description of log retention and S3 URI: s3://redwood-compliance/kaizen-review/2026-06/ (access controls documented)

What we do NOT provide: raw key material, unredacted operator identities, or private keystore exports. For the SIG reviewers who need signed confirmation, Irene will supply the attestation PDF and we can provide a short cover letter from our security lead if required (please say if you want it signed).

Access / delivery notes:
- SFTP path valid for 7 days from receipt of this email; presigned S3 links expire in 72 hours
- If Kaizen requires a sealed transfer or additional notarization, let us know and we can route through legal (this may add 3–5 business days)

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts satisfy the SIG fields in your worksheet. If you want a white-glove walk-through of the artifacts, we can schedule a 45-minute session with Connor and Irene next week.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
